title: Retaining walls and fill behind the street setback: setback per Table 3.5a
text: Retaining walls and fill within the site and behind the street setback to comply with Table 3.5a.

replaces.note: Part B Table 4: nil setback only for 0.5 m or less; now 1 m

notes: from: ch3 C3.5.2 (unchanged). Height measured from NGL at the lot boundary adjacent to that point of the wall (Table 3.5a note). R10-R25: nil-setback retaining height 0.5 m -> 1 m.

verified.note: Table 3.5a applies to retaining walls and fill behind the street setback; footnote 'take the nearest higher value' and the measurement note confirmed.
